groups.title: Measurements
groups.help: Use one reference: the highest finished-floor point along the entire travel. Record that datum in notes. Inches accept decimals or fractions such as 36 1/2; millimetres accept decimals. Blank means unknown. No dimensions are assumed.

groups.help: These are recorded observations, not signed approvals. Keep unresolved items and the person responsible in the notes. Follow the complete manufacturer checklist.
